cd /code && Rscript - <<'RS'
library(mFLICA)
leader<-mFLICA::TS[1,1:100,]
follower<-mFLICA::TS[2,1:100,]
obj<-dtw::dtw(x=follower,y=leader,k=TRUE)
ref <- leader[,1]
query <- follower[,1]
png('../results/fig2a.png', width=900, height=700)
plot(dtw::dtw(query, ref, k = TRUE), type = 'two', off = 1, match.lty = 2, match.indices = 100, xlab= 'Time',  ylab= 'Follower: x-axis positions')
mtext('Leader: x-axis positions', side = 4)
legend('left', c('follower', 'leader'), col = c('black', 'red'), lty = c(1, 2))
dev.off()
cat('done\n')
RS
ls -l ../results/fig2a.png
